_comment: Golden vectors for the Go-Stop near-yaku preview. Two implementations read this file: internal/domain/GoStop_test.go (GoStopComputeNearYaku) and frontend/src/utils/gostopYaku.golden.test.ts (computeNearYaku). Counts are the captured-card counts from the score breakdown; month-specific yaku are deliberately out of scope on both sides.

cases.name: nothing captured yet is too far from every threshold
three brights already scored: the next rung is sagwang
all five brights: nothing left to reach
ribbons, animals and junk can all be near at once
a category already past its threshold is not previewed again
three away is beyond the preview window
